## Edge Cases & Security Considerations

{{EDGE_CASES}}

<!-- Cover each:
### Password Reset Flow
- Reset token generation and expiration
- Secure delivery mechanism
- One-time use enforcement

### Account Lockout
- Failed attempt threshold and window
- Lockout duration and reset mechanism
- Notification to user

### Token Refresh
- Race condition handling for concurrent refresh requests
- Refresh token rotation (one-time use)
- Grace period for recently-rotated tokens

### Session Fixation Prevention
- New session ID on login
- Session invalidation on privilege change

### CSRF Protection
- Required if using cookie-based auth
- Double-submit cookie or synchronizer token pattern

### Multi-Device Sessions
- Concurrent session policy
- Session listing and selective revocation
-->

## Implementation Order

{{IMPLEMENTATION_ORDER}}

<!-- Ordered list ready for Jean to turn into tasks:
1. **User model + Alembic migration** — Create the User table with all auth fields

4. **Token middleware** — get_current_user dependency, JWT encode/decode
5. **Role middleware** — require_role dependency
6. **Protect existing endpoints** — Add auth dependencies to all routes
7. **Password reset flow** — Reset request, token email, reset confirmation
8. **Account lockout** — Failed attempt tracking, lockout logic
